svg.title: Complexity tests for part recognition in the wave sphere
svg.desc: Twelve synthetic scenes compare fixed-scale overlap, multiscale overlap, local intersection over union, and overlap with an oracle visibility mask.

g.text: Part recognition under increasing scene complexity
12 synthetic scenes on a 25 × 25 grid · One returning reference · Four scoring rules
Matched scene cells in the local IoU arm
Hidden cells, known only to the mask control
A correct pose requires position, angle and scale within tolerance.
